summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of PDF Studio web app (no backend). Verified all P0 flows: storage consent dialog, open PDF (start + topbar), multi-tab (new blank + open + switch + close), pen draw with pixel verification, eraser removal with pixel diff (678 -> 0), add blank page via TopBar menu, undo/redo for page ops, zoom in/out with label update, image page insertion via dialog, PDF download, local persistence across reload (recent files list), mobile viewport 390x844 (no horizontal scroll, sidebar overlay with backdrop that closes on thumb tap). All 16 test scenarios passed. No console/page errors observed (only benign Canvas2D willReadFrequently warnings).

issues: Benign browser warning: 'Canvas2D: Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with the willReadFrequently attribute set to true' — consider adding { willReadFrequently: true } to getContext('2d') calls that readback pixels (none from app code AFAICT, likely pdfEngine).

action_items: (Optional) Add { willReadFrequently: true } to 2D canvas contexts that read pixels back to suppress warning and improve perf

(Optional) autosave-indicator status 'On this device' (idle) can be confusing when no storage mode is chosen; the first-load storage dialog already prompts user but if auto-dismissed, label 'On this device' may not match reality — consider renaming idle label.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.js is 574 lines — close to 700 line threshold. Consider splitting storage/consent logic and doc operations into hooks (useDocsReducer, useStorageConsent) for maintainability.
In Workspace.js downloadDoc() uses exportScale default of 2 (via exportPdf.js) — large edited docs with many pages may be memory heavy on Android; could expose a quality setting.
In Reader.js pinch-zoom useEffect uses empty deps and relies on refs — fine, but startScale captured on touchstart may drift if user keeps fingers down across state updates (acceptable).
StorageDialog cannot be dismissed by click-outside the first time (good) but has no explicit X close; relying on user to pick Local or Session is intentional. OK.
PageView eraser uses removed.current Set with no persistence until pointerup — correct and works as verified by pixel diff.
exportPdf.js rasterizes every page at scale=2 to PNG then embeds — produces large PDF files for text PDFs; downgrade: text becomes images (no searchability). Known tradeoff for WYSIWYG.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/pdftest/sample.pdf (3-page reportlab PDF) and /tmp/pdftest/sample.png (400x300) for upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 flows verified on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844). Sidebar overlay + backdrop + thumb-tap-close all working. Download produced 'sample.pdf' from the browser. Storage persistence across reload confirmed via recents list. Prior iteration_4 referred to pre-rewrite UI and is outdated.
